title: K80 GPU v71 map-bound start owner
status: offline source/build candidate; unselected, unpackaged, and unbooted
v71_changes: RegisterMaps exposes a private BoardOwner-only predicate that requires the exact retained InactiveOwner, mapsReady, accepted GPU/GMU register views, exact provider/resource descriptor identities, and live provider claims before and after checking.
InactiveOwner passes its exact identity and retained RegisterMaps instance to the MMU and GPU OOB owner methods.

DarwinBoardOwner requires the same parent/maps pair for MMU start and OOB, verifies that its retained SMMU global-I/O guard is bound to that RegisterMaps instance, retains both owners after successful MMU startup, and checks the callback service/resource pair against that map before granting the one-shot GPU-start window.
